html.help.close.title: Close (`Esc`)
html.help.keyboard: **Keyboard**. `Tab` and `Shift Tab` move between controls. `Enter` or `Space` activates a control. `Up`, `Down`, `Home` and `End` move through menus and lists. `Esc` closes panels and returns focus. **Focus the picture** for camera and playback keys. On Field the arrow keys turn the camera, Watch uses `Alt` with the arrows. `+` and `-` zoom. Color fields also accept hex values.
html.help.start.title: Getting started
html.help.start: **Watch**, open a file or choose a source. **Recordings**, browse saved games. Record a batch with `cuju.render.Recorder`. Watch live with `cuju.render.watch`. **Matches**, choose teams and request a game. **Play**, choose a side and start.
html.help.pages.title: Pages
html.help.pages: **Home**, choose an activity. **Teams**, import submissions and edit players. **Field**, arrange the pitch and stadium. **Help**, find controls and guides. `Mod K`, or the search button in the top bar, opens the **command palette** on any page.
html.help.teams.title: Making a team
html.help.teams: A team is a **submission folder** in the format of Kaggle's football competition, whose `main.py` defines the agent as its last function. Add the folder on the Teams page, or with `cuju render team add`, then pick the team on Matches or Play. The built-in AI is always a team.
html.help.play.title: Play controls
html.help.play: `Left` `Right` `Up` `Down` move. `S` passes short, `W` passes long, `A` passes high or tackles, `D` shoots. Hold `E` to sprint and `C` to dribble. `Esc` pauses. The **input settings** on Play change these keys and the dead zone of the stick. On a touch screen a stick and the buttons of play show over the game.
html.help.pad: **Controller**, {0} left stick or {1} D pad moves. {2} passes short, {3} shoots, {4} passes high or tackles, {5} passes long. {6} sprints, {7} dribbles. {8} pauses, {9} shows controls. The controls card in Play sets up other controllers.
html.help.pause: **Home pauses** your game. Return to Play to Resume or Quit. Quit to Home ends the game and **saves it** when Save to Recordings is selected.

tour.step.match.text: The **Match** menu opens a recording, a live source or one goal of the match that plays.

show.guide.title: How grades work
show.guide.grades: Grades run from F through D, C, B and A to S, with minus and plus steps between. A player with too little time shows a dash. Roles come from the starting position.
show.guide.rating: A rating starts at 5. Contribution per 30 minutes, capped at three times, counts goals 1.4, assists 1, shots on target 0.25, key passes 0.35, tackles 0.6 for a goalkeeper or defender and 0.35 otherwise, and goalkeeper saves 0.65. Passing adds accuracy less 0.65, times 1.5, after three passes. A clean sheet adds 1 for a goalkeeper or defender and 0.3 otherwise. Own goals cost 2, yellow cards 0.4 and red cards 1.5.
show.guide.charts: The charts split the match into twelve equal periods. Possession is a line around an even split, in the color of the first team above the middle and of the second below, and leaves out time when neither team holds the ball. Territory and possession averages the ball position and the side in possession, and a line above the middle favours the first team.
